cohort: Low-risk parturients with a reactive fetal heart rate at arrival in labor
finding: The study found that continuous electronic fetal monitoring (CEFM) was associated with an increased rate of operative deliveries and improved neonatal outcomes, but these findings were not consistent across all Robson's classification groups.
mod_finding: Continuous electronic fetal monitoring (CEFM) was associated with an increased rate of operative deliveries overall.
